paper.title: Applications of fMRI for Brain Mapping

result.summary: 本文是一篇综述，介绍脑映射技术及 fMRI 信号处理方法，指出仅靠结构成像不足以应对许多神经疾病，需要研究脑的功能组织 [abstract]。文章概述了多种脑映射技术，并说明脑映射有助于获取脑功能以及负责运动、感觉、言语和记忆等特定活动的脑区信息 [abstract]。

research_question.text: 论文关注的问题是：正常解剖成像只能提供脑部某些异常的结构信息，但许多神经疾病仅靠结构研究并不充分，因此需要研究脑的功能组织，并需要在正常与疾病状态下研究脑功能 [abstract]。

evidence.quote: Normal anatomical imaging can provide structural information on certain abnormalities in the brain.
However there are many neurological disorders for which only structure studies are not sufficient.
In such cases it is required to investigate the functional organization of the brain.
Further it is necessary to study the brain functions under normal as well as diseased conditions.

method.text: 作者采用综述的方式，概述多种脑映射技术以及 fMRI 信号处理方法 [abstract]。

evidence.quote: The authors provide an overview of various Brain Mapping techniques and fMRI signal processing methods.

findings.text: 脑映射技术被证明对理解脑的分子、细胞和功能机制至关重要 [abstract]。脑映射技术有助于获取关于脑功能以及负责运动、感觉、言语和记忆等特定活动的脑区的重要信息 [abstract]。

evidence.quote: Brain-mapping techniques have proven to be vital in understanding the molecular, cellular, and functional mechanisms of the brain.
Brain mapping techniques can help in deriving useful and important information on these issues.
Brain functions and brain area responsible for the particular activities like motor, sensory speech and memory process could be investigated.
